Malden City Hall, Room 108, 215 Pleasant St, Malden, MA
and Remote access via Teams

## AGENDA
1. Open meeting and roll call (5 minutes)
2. Approval of minutes of August 26 meeting (5 minutes)
3. Treasurer's update (10 minutes)
4. Vote to extend current board officers to January meeting and discussion of board roles (20 minutes)
5. Review and discuss grant evaluation tool (40 minutes)
6. Overview of November and December meetings (10 minutes)

summary: The council will get a Treasurer's update, vote on extending current board officers to the January meeting, discuss board roles, review the grant evaluation tool, and preview the November and December meetings.
